capabilities_rationale: Instructions only: the skill ships no scripts, so its code can do nothing. The agent following it writes Markdown files under docs/lessons-learnt/ with its own tools; that is the host agent's capability, governed by the host's permission prompts, not this skill's.

tested_platforms.notes: Used once to write docs/lessons-learnt/2026-10-31_* during the repository audit. That run was not captured as an eval (no with/without-skill baseline, no grading), so it is recorded as NOT_RUN rather than PASS.

security_audit.method: Markdown instruction-surface scan (no scripts to analyse).
security_audit.enforcement: Re-runs on every push and pull request; the content digest below stops matching if any file here is edited without re-attesting.
